title: Transition W11: consume the eshyra-jhpt campaign-rule read interface from discovery
description:
Workstream W11 of the integrated ADR 0020 transition design, section 8 (the
narrow campaign-rule read interface discovery requires):
docs/audits/rules-awareness-transition/2026-07-30-integrated-transition-design.md.
That design is the accepted deliverable of eshyra-o9bd.19.8 (PR #485, reviewed
head afd113c7090378c3a9f4122f246a6c32602a5164, merge commit
042ce119aa699f04f60a1885d471335f07745282). ADR 0020 controls.

OWNER
This bead owns ONLY the discovery-side consumption of the eshyra-jhpt read
interface. eshyra-jhpt and its nine children remain the authoritative owner of
campaign rules and ambiguity rulings. This bead consumes that runtime; it does
not replace, duplicate, or extend it.

SCOPE (discovery side only)
Replace the W8 stub seam with real consumption of the eshyra-jhpt runtime, so
that the discovery stage pipeline and the W10 context packet can:

- request active campaign rules applicable at the adjudicated campaign position,
  through the same active-at-position query the auditor uses (eshyra-jhpt.3,
  backed by .2);
- request active rulings for discovered RulesAmbiguity IDs (eshyra-jhpt.6);
- carry ruling identity, campaign scope, provenance, and supersession status
  through to the packet unchanged (eshyra-jhpt.1, .2);
- place an active rule or ruling beside its governing pack record or ambiguity,
  using association data supplied by jhpt (amendment A1 on eshyra-jhpt.3);
- pass an active ruling to bounded capability preflight where execution depends
  on it (amendment A2 on eshyra-jhpt.6, designed with the eshyra-olc5 readiness
  owner because assertMagicItemOperationReady runs before matchStateTransition);
- record retrieval evidence in the existing accepted-turn trace (amendment A3 on
  eshyra-jhpt.4/.9), so M5 is measurable without a discovery-owned store;
- preserve the absence case: a discovered ambiguity with no active ruling keeps
  its uncertainty and never acquires silent canonical certainty
  (eshyra-jhpt.3, .6; probe P7).

THIS BEAD DOES NOT OWN, AND MUST NOT DEFINE
- the campaign-rule schema;
- the ruling schema;
- persistence or storage of rules or rulings;
- rule/ruling recording, authoring, or management tools;
- active-rule resolution (the active-at-position query);
- supersession or revocation;
- house-rule lifecycle.

All seven belong to eshyra-jhpt. Campaign overlay lore (ADR 0014,
world/campaignOverlayLore.ts) is not a substitute: it models world canon with
truth/significance/visibility, not a selected rules interpretation tied to an
ambiguity. Discovery may not resolve an ambiguity, and a capability may not
consult a ruling that did not come through jhpt.

If the jhpt interface proves insufficient, the correct response is an amendment
or a new child under eshyra-jhpt, never a discovery-local store, table, cache of
record, or shadow resolver (design section 14.3).

NON-GOALS
No ranker, ontology, or relationship vocabulary; no universal
discovery-completeness claim; no corpus-wide capability claim; no finding
disposition.

DEPENDENCIES
eshyra-jhpt.3 for the campaign-rule path; eshyra-jhpt.6 additionally for the
ruling path (which itself rests on .1, .2, .4, .5). Interface-consumption design
may proceed in parallel; the integration may not.

PERMANENT EVIDENCE
Interface-consumption tests against the real jhpt active-at-position query
(not a discovery-local fake once jhpt has landed), covering: an active rule
placed beside its governing record; an active ruling placed beside its
ambiguity; the unresolved-ambiguity absence case; supersession and revocation
reflected in what discovery receives; and an assertion that no discovery-side
rule or ruling store exists.

REQUIRED NEXT STATE
The W8 stub seam is backed by the real jhpt runtime; W10 can populate the
packet's campaign-rule and ruling fields; probe P7's ruling case and probe P10's
house-rule case run against real jhpt data.

MATERIAL CHANGE: no. It consumes an already-owned runtime across an existing
ownership boundary and adds no new authority.
acceptance_criteria:
Discovery obtains active campaign rules and active ambiguity rulings only
through the eshyra-jhpt runtime, using the same active-at-position query the
auditor uses; no discovery-side campaign-rule schema, ruling schema, persistence
table, recording tool, active-rule resolver, supersession or revocation
mechanism, or house-rule lifecycle exists anywhere in the discovery path, and a
test asserts their absence. Rule and ruling identity, kind, campaign scope,
provenance, effective position, and supersession status survive unchanged into
the packet. An active rule or ruling is placed beside its governing pack record
or ambiguity using association data supplied by jhpt (amendment A1), not
re-derived by discovery. Where execution depends on a ruling, the ruling reaches
bounded capability preflight only through the jhpt path (amendment A2), and a
capability never consults a ruling that did not come through jhpt. Retrieval
evidence lands in the existing accepted-turn trace (amendment A3), so M5 is
measurable without a discovery-owned store. A discovered ambiguity with no
active ruling preserves its uncertainty, surfaces the published interpretations,
and never acquires silent canonical certainty. Tests run against the real jhpt
query once eshyra-jhpt.3 and .6 have landed; the W8 stub is not accepted as
final evidence. Probe P7's ruling case and probe P10's house-rule case pass
against real jhpt data.
notes: Correction to close reason: the residual ownership-checker limitations are recorded on eshyra-txa2 (not eshyra-vk4e, which was a placeholder written before the bead was created and does not exist).
close_reason: Merged to main as PR #538, merge commit a9196de, approved in substance at exact head 66cff8a under the rules-clause-complete profile (66cff8a verified an ancestor of origin/main). Delivered W11: discovery consumes the real eshyra-jhpt read interface via createCampaignRuleReadSeam. Every probe execution persists its declared campaign-rule cases through jhpt's own writers and runs at a real persisted campaign position, asserting each rule reached the packet under the identity jhpt assigned; the W8 stub and its test are deleted. Amendment A2 wired into the offline packet's capability preflight carrying the jhpt-owned CampaignRulingProjection unchanged. A1 and A3 were already landed by jhpt and are consumed, not redefined. Permanent evidence in campaignRuleConsumption.test.ts and discoveryOwnershipBoundary.test.ts. Two review rounds: F1 (a discovery-owned ruling schema at the A2 boundary) and F2 (an ownership checker that recognized spellings and false-greened on F1) were both repaired; the reviewer's third pass withdrew a further F2 generalization as disproportionate. Residual checker limitations recorded on eshyra-vk4e. W9 (eshyra-o9bd.19.11) and W10 (eshyra-o9bd.19.12) are unblocked by this closure.
